note: Triennial election of the Downpatrick rural district council, 1933; polling day for Co. Down, Thursday 25 May 1933. There were no contests: the only division with two nominations was Killyleagh Urban, where Mr. J. H. Wightman withdrew in favour of the sitting member (Belfast News-Letter, 27 April 1933, p. 16, and 4 May 1933, p. 9). The other divisions are not named. Sitting member; Mr. J. H. Wightman was nominated and withdrew. Returned unopposed.
